description: Shapes for kind "shape" (and model parts). Solids fit a 1 m box; flat shapes are puffy cut-outs facing the camera, for 2D shape names. Every shape stands on y = 0. Add face: true for eyes and a smile.

block.description: A toy block: a cube with rounded edges, size 1.

cone.description: A party hat cone, diameter 1, height 1.

circle.description: A flat puffy circle (round, no corners), width 1.

square.description: A flat puffy square: four equal sides, four corners.

triangle.description: A flat puffy triangle: three sides, three corners.

rectangle.description: A flat puffy rectangle: two long sides, two short sides, width 1.4.

oval.description: A flat puffy oval (a stretched circle, like an egg lying down), width 1.24.

capsule.description: A pill shape (model parts: tails, ears).

box.description: A box with slightly rounded edges (model parts). Thinner than about 0.05 its corners turn to slivers: use plate for thin slabs.

plate.description: A thin rounded slab, 1 x 0.04 x 1, built at its true thickness so it stays solid: boards, mats, signs, trays and plates. Scale x and z for its size (scale y to make it thicker or thinner); stand it up with rotation [90, 0, 0].

pentagon.description: A flat puffy pentagon: five sides, five corners.

hexagon.description: A flat puffy hexagon: six sides, six corners (like a honeycomb cell).

octagon.description: A flat puffy octagon: eight sides (like a stop sign).

half_circle.description: A flat half circle, flat side down (a half pizza, a rainbow base).

quarter_circle.description: A flat quarter circle: a quarter of a pizza, corner at the origin.

arrow.description: A flat arrow pointing right (+x); turn it to point anywhere (maps, directions).

cross.description: A flat X mark (treasure maps, wrong answers).

drop.description: A flat water drop, pointed at the top.

leaf.description: A thin flat leaf with pointed ends (falling leaves, plants).

ring.description: A flat ring with a round hole in the middle.

hoop.description: A sorting hoop: a thin flat band lying on the floor (1 m across, outer radius 0.5, inner 0.45, 0.03 tall, rounded edges). Use size for its width (size 2: a 2 m hoop), and put things inside it to sort them.

cup.description: An open cup or jar, 1 m tall: thin walls and a bottom, so you can see into it (glasses, jugs, tubs, buckets).

pot.description: A flower pot or bucket: wider at the top, with a rim, open.

bowl.description: An open bowl, 1 wide and 0.5 tall.

tube.description: An open pipe with no ends (tunnels, pipes, a telescope).

bottle.description: A bottle with a neck, open at the top.

dome.description: Half a ball, flat side down, 0.5 tall (igloos, dens, hills).

disc.description: A coin-like disc with a raised rim, 0.12 thick.

wedge.description: A ramp (a triangular prism): slopes up from +x to -x, depth 1 (slides, ramps, cheese).

tick.description: A flat tick mark (right answers, a done checklist).

grin.description: An open-mouthed grin (a D shape: lip line curving up at the corners), width 1, facing +z (plush faces).

brow.description: A thick arched eyebrow with round ends, width 1 (plush faces).

brim.description: A cap brim: a flat rounded peak pointing +z that curves down a little, about 1 wide and 0.66 deep.

cape.description: A flared cape open at the front, 1 tall and 1 wide at the hem, solid on both sides.

mask.description: A domino eye mask with two eye holes, bent to fit round a head, width about 0.86.

bao.description: A steamed dumpling: a squat ball whose top gathers in twisting pleats.

gumdrop.description: A gumdrop: round top, sides widening a little to a rounded base, 1 tall.

egg.description: An egg: widest a third of the way up, with a narrower round top, 1 tall (round plush bodies).

egg_seat.description: The seat of a pair of shorts for an egg body: the egg's bottom 23%, closed on top. Not centred: give it the egg's centre and a slightly bigger scale.

egg_shirt.description: A sleeveless shirt band for an egg body: the egg's band from 8% to 35% of its height (the belly, under a face on the upper half), open top and bottom, solid inside. Not centred: give it the egg's centre and a slightly bigger scale.

bao_drop.description: An onion-shaped steamed bun: round belly, a tuck at the collar, widest just above it, soft pleats gathering into a pinch on top (spans y -0.5..0.5).

bao_head.description: The top of bao_drop above the collar line (closed underneath), for a head that tilts; not centred: give it bao_drop's centre and scale.

bao_belly.description: The bottom of bao_drop below the collar line (closed on top), with soft folds; not centred: give it bao_drop's centre and scale.

bao_knot.description: A small ruched ball of dough with twisting lobes: a bun's top knot.

leaf_collar.description: An upright leaf collar band (top radius 0.5 at y 0, 0.1 deep) dipping in front, with a seam where the leaf overlaps; add collar_lip and leaf_flap.

brow_thin.description: A thin arched eyebrow tapering to points, width 1.

eyelid.description: A cartoon upper-lid line with an outer flick and a thin lower line, for the wide anime eye (models.js eyes.iris + eyes.lid).

collar_lip.description: A thin rolled ring of radius 0.5 lying flat: the lip on top of leaf_collar.

leaf_flap.description: A cupped pointed leaf, 1 long down -y from its stem end, faces toward +x, edges curling up: a collar's side flap.

grin_wide.description: A big open grin: the lip line curving up at the corners, a deep round bottom (width 1, about 0.5 tall).
